description:
Build a seeded single or double elimination bracket (padded to the next power of two, byes to the top seeds, standard 1 v n seeding) or a round robin schedule by the circle method. Players are given in seed order. Returns the round-one pairings, byes, every round and a printable text version.

Returns: Elimination: JSON { format, players, bracketSize, byes, gamesNeeded{ min, max }, rounds[{ name, matches[{ id, top, bottom, walkover }] }], text }. Round robin: { format, players, rounds[{ round, games[[a, b]], sitsOut }], games, text }. Later-round slots read TBD.
Example input: {"players":["Alder","Birch","Cedar","Hazel","Maple","Rowan"],"format":"single"}
On error, includes hint: List players strongest first; pass format 'double' for a losers bracket or 'round-robin' for everyone-plays-everyone. Shuffle the list yourself for random seeding.

players.description: Player or team names in seed order (seed 1 first). Names must be unique.

name: tournament_bracket
